name: Crewtide
summary: A ferry crew HR and roster app with a live departures board, moving route map and rest checks
about: A nine-page crew HR and rostering app for ferries and other teams that run on shifts and departures, with light and dark themes and sample data. A split-flap departures board shows each sailing's crew status, and a route map moves the ferries with the timetable. Drag duties between crew and days, see which sailings are short of crew, check rest hours, renew certificates, approve leave and run payroll with payslips.
how: Open pages from the icon rail on the left (the menu button on a phone); the clock in the top bar is live.
On Bridge, watch the departures board flip in and the ferries move along their routes; hover a ferry for its crossing.
On Roster, filter by vessel and drag duties between crew and days (Alt copies, M moves with the keyboard); rest clashes turn red.
On Sailings, step through days to see every crossing, how many of its five crew are on duty, and cancel or restore a sailing.
On Rest hours, see who is under the rest rules in the last 24 hours or 7 days, and on Crew renew certificates.
On Leave and Payroll, approve leave, then approve and pay the month and open any payslip.
